svg.title: One fixed-point update step with MixerEquation
svg.desc: The latest iterate and observations are encoded once. A draw-free path and a per-draw path, run separately for each of K draws, produce terms that are combined into the estimate. The integrator steps the iterate toward it, which is committed to the carry and exposed to the predictor.
svg.text: ↻ a(t) is read by the next block
Teal: draw-free path · Coral: per-draw path, run separately for each draw
